awards.name: Berkeley Haas MFE Partial-Tuition Merit Scholarship
awards.description: All MFE candidates are considered for a partial-tuition Merit Scholarship with no separate application; typically offered with the admissions decision. Haas also lists donor-named awards (Matrosova Leadership, Arthur Qi Book $1,000, Mark Rubinstein Fellowship) and a general need-based scholarship via the scholarship portal aligned to admission rounds. Limited funding; earlier rounds advised.
awards.eligibility: Admitted Berkeley Haas MFE students (FT or Flex). Page addresses scholarships to admitted students without citizenship carve-out on the merit auto-consider language; international students have access to limited scholarships (most aid is loans).
awards.amount: Partial tuition (amount unpublished); Qi Book Award $1,000 when awarded
awards.deadline: With admission (merit); donor/need apps aligned to admission round deadlines
awards.note: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. Spring-only program. SIEML alumni full first-year fee coverage is pathway-only — see SCH-148 ingest:false. Veterans benefits separate.

awards.name: CMU MSCF Merit Fellowship
awards.description: All admitted MSCF students are automatically reviewed for an MSCF Merit Fellowship. Awards are partial; MSCF Fellowship awards up to $60,000 for the entirety of the program based on overall strength of the applicant relative to the pool and contribution to representation within the MSCF community. Fellowship page notes ~25% of incoming students receive fellowships.
awards.eligibility: Admitted CMU MSCF students (Pittsburgh or NYC). Automatic consideration; no separate fellowship application. International students are not eligible for CMU need-based/federal aid but merit fellowship language is not citizenship-restricted on the MSCF tuition/aid page.
awards.amount: Up to $60,000 for full program (partial; ~25% of incoming class per fellowship page)
awards.note: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. External lists on same page (AAUW, Soros, Numerix Women in Finance, etc.) are not MSCF-tied SCH cards.

awards.eligibility: Admitted Columbia Engineering MS students including IEOR MSFE. No citizenship restriction stated on the Dean's MS Academic Excellence Fellowship description.
awards.note: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. Applies to columbia-ieor-mfe only — do NOT attach to CBS columbia-msfe.

awards.name: Columbia Engineering CMA CGM Excellence Fund for Education

awards.description: Merit-based fellowship for outstanding Columbia Engineering master's students demonstrating academic excellence, financial need, and interest in applying technology/analytics to global challenges (logistics, infrastructure, data-driven decisions, sustainability, finance, AI). awards.eligibility: Admitted/applicant Columbia Engineering MS students who apply for the award after submitting the Engineering application. Not citizenship-limited on the published description; Lebanon interest is a preference factor, not a hard nationality lock.
awards.deadline: After Columbia Engineering application submission (see funding page for cycle details)
awards.note: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. Preference language for Lebanon — still open apply path for HK/TW/PRC if theme fit; not a pathway-only lock.

awards.name: Stanford ICME Limited MS Teaching/Course & Research Assistantships
awards.state: Competitive; not guaranteed; often via faculty/CA application after enrollment
awards.description: ICME does not offer guaranteed financial support for MS students. Limited TA/CA and occasional RA appointments may cover 8–10 units tuition plus salary at 50% time (20 hrs/week); reduced 25% appointments possible. MCF FAQ: admissions need-blind; no practice of linking guaranteed financial support to admission offers.
awards.eligibility: ICME MS students (including MCF track) who secure competitive TA/CA or RA. RA typically via faculty contact; TA/CA via ICME CA application (SUNet). Open without citizenship lock on ICME funding page; federal loans US-only.
awards.amount: Tuition coverage 8–10 units + monthly salary at standard assistantship rates (exact $ unpublished on ICME page)
awards.deadline: After enrollment / faculty arrangement (not automatic with admission)
awards.note: SEPARATE TRACK quant-mfe. Vuolteenaho Family Fellowship is Aalto-pathway — SCH-151 ingest:false. Knight-Hennessy / SGF are PhD-oriented — not MCF MS cards.
